206-240-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2438-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2438-4694-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-883-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-883-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-7492.description:
Cast Mogg Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3179-4399-4770-6097.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

5147-7124-7760.easyPrerequisites: You've discarded at least one card this turn.
5147-7124-7760.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7760.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Living Laser as attackers.
Living Laser triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-5645-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4694-5256-7652.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2103-4823-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-2642-4050-7495.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2438-3490-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2438-3490-5445-7426.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

457-944-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-944-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3129-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-4488-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4488-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5073-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
5073-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

883-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

918-4090-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Donna Noble instead due to Pariah.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

431-1308-3129-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-3129-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1729-2178-3113.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Fire Whip attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

165-1069-4927-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-4927-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-5226.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-5226.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1987-4276-4477-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4477-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Revolutionist and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4477-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2099-2719-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2099-2719-5365.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
2099-2719-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

914-3525-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
914-3525-5921-5970-6120.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1621-3668.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flesh Duplicate.
1621-3668.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Flesh Duplicate. Choose to have Flesh Duplicate enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1283-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
215-1283-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
215-1283-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {2}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

165-1283-2034-3560.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
165-1283-2034-3560.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {3}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus and Spirit, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1365-2744-4404-5147.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2744-4404-5147.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

539-862-2232-2374.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, it and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

774-2081-2137.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two lands.
You control at least one additional creature.
774-2081-2137.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Culling the Weak.
Resolve the copy of Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.

2034-4763-4766.notablePrerequisites: Deahrender attached to another nontoken creature you control.
2034-4763-4766.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1110-2019-2906-5256.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
1110-2019-2906-5256.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-4370.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4370.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Darksteel Relic to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Darksteel Relic.
Cast Darksteel Relic.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2556-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2427-2556-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
